items.title: Closed points with finite separable residue field are dense on a smooth scheme over a field
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: If X is smooth over the spectrum of a field k, the lemma shows that the closed points whose residue field is a finite separable extension of k form a dense subset (statement lines 4657-4666). It suffices to find one such point in every nonempty open, so the proof chooses a diagram in which X receives an etale morphism from an open subscheme of an affine space; etaleness makes that morphism open, and the affine space case supplies a closed point with finite separable residue field inside its image (proof lines 4668-4684). Lifting that point along the etale morphism preserves finite separability of the residue field extension by the structure of etale morphisms over a field, and the lifted point is closed in X because algebraic residue field extensions characterize closed points (proof lines 4684-4690). The claim is H2: three standard inputs arranged so that the problem is transferred to affine space and back, with no step referred to the reader.
